bodyHtml:
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family Safety & Screen Time · Logan & Surrounds

Family Safety & Screen Time Solutions Logan. Healthy Digital Habits, Made Simple.

In today's digital world, managing your child's screen time can feel overwhelming. We make it simple and stress-free to create healthy digital habits for your family, setting up screen time limits, blocking distracting apps, and monitoring usage across all devices, so you can keep your kids safe and balanced online.

Protect My Kids Online
✓ Parental Control Setup
✓ Screen Time Schedules
✓ Monitoring & Alerts
✓ On-Site or Remote
Onsite & Remote Consultations

Guidance Wherever You Are.

Onsite visits are perfect for busy parents who want everything set up in one go, no stress, no confusion. Remote sessions let us guide you step by step, wherever you are. For example, we regularly help families set up parental controls on their kids' tablets before school holidays.

Device Compatibility

Every Device In The House, Covered.

We help you set up and manage parental controls across Apple devices (iPads, iPhones, MacBooks), Android phones and tablets, Windows and macOS computers, game consoles and smart TVs, and home WiFi routers for network-level protection.

Parental Control App Setup

The Most Trusted Apps, Configured For You.

We specialise in the most trusted apps for total family peace of mind.

🛡️

Qustodio

App blocking, usage tracking, and daily schedules.

👨‍👩‍👧

Google Family Link

Manage apps and bedtime settings for Android devices.

🔍

Net Nanny

Real-time content filtering and alerts.

🎮

Microsoft Family Safety

Keep kids safe on Windows, Xbox and Android.

📡

Router-Based Solutions

Home-wide filtering that covers every device on the network. See our wireless network setup service.

🔐

Account Security

Want everyone's accounts locked down too? See password manager & 2FA setup.

Example: helping a family configure Qustodio on four tablets and two laptops, each with its own profile.

Screen Time Schedules & Agreements

Rules That Actually Fit Your Family.

Weekday vs weekend limits, shared family rules for mealtimes, bedtime and study times, age-appropriate plans that grow with your children, and app-specific time restrictions. For example, weekday screen limits for school nights with more relaxed rules for family movie nights.

Monitoring, Reports & Alerts

Stay Informed, Without Feeling Like You're Spying.

Alerts if kids try to bypass controls, weekly usage reports straight to your email, visibility into which apps they're using the most, and early warning of potential problems before they grow.

Digital Wellbeing Coaching

It's Not Just About The Tech, It's About Balance.

We help your family find balance too, not just install software.

  • Digital wellbeing tips. For healthier online habits across the whole family.
  • Offline activities. Advice on encouraging family time away from screens.
  • Family agreements. Building rules that support healthy boundaries.
  • Age-appropriate conversations. Guidance on discussing online safety with kids.

Example: working with a family to create "no screens at dinner" rules and weekly digital detox challenges.

Related Services

Rounding Out Your Family's Digital Safety.

Setting up new phones or tablets for the kids first? Start with our mobile device setup service. Want network-wide filtering that protects every device automatically? See wireless network setup. Locking down the whole family's account security while you're at it? Check out password manager & 2FA setup. Setting up the family TV with parental profiles too? See Smart TV & streaming setup.

Benefits

Why Families Invest In A Proper Screen Time Setup.

  • Better focus. For school and hobbies.
  • Safer online experiences. For your kids, every day.
  • Improved sleep and wellbeing. With sensible bedtime limits.
  • Reduced stress for parents. Fewer fights about devices.
  • Stronger family relationships. Through balanced tech use.
Frequently Asked Questions

Family Safety & Screen Time Questions, Answered.

What is the recommended screen time for children?

It varies by age, but Australian guidelines suggest no more than 2 hours of recreational screen time for school-aged children, with plenty of breaks and physical activity in between.

How do I choose the right parental control app for my family?

It depends on your goals, some apps offer web filtering and app blocking, while others focus on screen time scheduling or location tracking. We can help you compare and pick the best app for your needs.

Is it possible to set up parental controls for multiple kids on one account?

Absolutely, most leading apps like Qustodio and Google Family Link allow you to create multiple child profiles and manage them separately.

Can you help set up Family Sharing and device monitoring on Apple devices?

Yes, Apple's Family Sharing and Screen Time features are great tools, we'll show you how to set them up for seamless management across iPads, iPhones and Macs.

What happens if my child tries to bypass parental controls?

Many apps alert you when kids attempt to remove or bypass limits. We'll also teach you how to harden settings and keep controls secure.

Do these solutions protect against online dangers like cyberbullying?

While parental controls can't stop cyberbullying, they help you monitor usage and block risky content. We can also advise on safe communication tools and teaching kids about online safety.

How often should I review or update screen time settings?

We recommend reviewing settings every few months, or whenever your child's routine changes (like starting high school). We'll help you adjust them as needed.

Can you integrate these controls into our home network or WiFi?

Yes! Some routers and WiFi systems have built-in parental controls. We can help you integrate network-level controls for an extra layer of protection.

Stop Device Battles Before They Start.

Learn how our screen time solutions can make parenting easier, book your free consultation today.
